Player Impressions:
Hoyos - made one good save 🧤 to push the ball over the net.  Has also nearly gifted Montréal several balls
Báez - he's been getting better by the game.  Shutting down his side.  Has also created 2 chances
Alonso - I actually forgot he was on the pitch for the first 20.  He started getting involved after the first goal, and has made an impact since.
Díaz - has given away a couple of easy plays.  Nearly got an assist on the Embolo head-shot
Edwards - playing very well on the right.  setting up shome higher up the pitch and becoming an outlet for passes
Amaro - has given the ball away too easy.  Those runs where he didn't pass cannot happen.  Has played better locking down the back.
Almirón - doing everything he can to motivate the team and be the tallisman.  I didn't his shot would make it to goal - looked better on replay.
Galoppo - has taken a few shots.  Haven't always been coming off, but he's trying.  And was in the right place, right time for the goal.
Fortune - better contribution tonight than last game.  Doing decent with distribution, could be doing more.
Miranchuk - orchestrating well, coming back deep to help out on defense.  overall a positive night so far.
Embolo - a good header attempt.  That first offside shot - TAKE THE SHOT, don't assume you're off.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos - took things too easy in the first half, came up with more good late saves.  
Báez - didn't put a foot wrong tonight.  starting to show his worth.
Alonso - settled the backline in the 2nd half.  has been getting further up pitch lately.
Díaz - some nervous moments in distribution.  does well in his defensive duties when under pressure
Edwards - immense tonight.  a clear upgrade over Jacobs.  Plays to earn a starting spot.
Amaro - far too many errors in distrbution.  Seems to come alive when he's heading back to defend
Almirón - a DP worthy night.  
Galoppo - right place, right time.  his influence faded in the 2nd
Fortune - Got better as the night went on, before coming off.  
Miranchuk - repeatedly came deep to help settle defense.  Kept the ball moving up.  Still needs to be doing more
Embolo - Finally got his goal.  His reaction shots are really good.  The mroe time he has, the more trouble he has

Alzate - he was there.  had a couple nice plays, otherwise didn't influence
Santos - he had a super effective night getting the ball up the pitch, retaining possession, being a nuisance.  Where was he all year?
Sanchez - didn't produce a lot on the ball.  He was much better off the ball, keeping control of midfield and preventing Montréal from getting possession
Picault - some long balls nearly came off
Muyumba - a couple of really good defensive plays to prevent Montréal clear attacks

Tata - didn't wait as long to make subs.  his starting 11 were clearly better than Montréal.  Subs shut up shop.
